settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.description: Find answers about TOOSA tool storage, delivery, assembly, warranties, showroom visits and custom services.
settings.faq_1_answer: TOOSA offers modular tool storage systems, rolling tool chests, workshop accessories, foam organization products, custom foam inserts and industrial air compressor solutions.
settings.faq_2_question: Can I see TOOSA products before purchasing?
settings.faq_2_answer: Yes. Selected products can be viewed at our Richmond, BC showroom. We recommend booking an appointment before visiting.
settings.faq_3_question: Can you help me choose the right tool storage system?
settings.faq_3_answer: Yes. Contact our team with information about your workspace, storage requirements and the tools you need to organize. We can help you compare available configurations.
settings.faq_4_question: Do TOOSA tool chests require assembly?
settings.faq_4_answer: Some TOOSA storage products require assembly. Instructions and the required hardware are provided where applicable.
settings.faq_5_question: Can TOOSA assemble my product for me?
settings.faq_5_answer: Professional assembly services are available on eligible products for an additional charge.
settings.faq_6_question: Can I add my company logo to my tool box?
settings.faq_6_answer: Laser engraving is available for eligible TOOSA products. Contact us or submit your design to discuss your requirements.
settings.faq_7_question: Do you make custom foam tool inserts?
settings.faq_7_answer: Yes. TOOSA can create precision-cut custom foam layouts based on your tools, dimensions or supplied design.
settings.faq_8_question: Can I pick up my order?
settings.faq_8_answer: Yes. Free local curbside pickup is available from our Richmond warehouse. Schedule your pickup after placing your order.
settings.faq_9_question: Do you deliver outside the Lower Mainland?
settings.faq_9_answer: Yes. Contact TOOSA for a delivery quote based on your destination and order requirements.
settings.faq_10_answer: Local Lower Mainland delivery is currently listed at $100 CAD. Orders above $3,000 qualify for free shipping, while other locations may require a custom quote.
settings.faq_11_question: Do TOOSA products include a warranty?
settings.faq_11_answer: TOOSA currently provides a one-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects on its products. Product-specific warranties may vary, particularly for specialized equipment such as air compressors.
settings.faq_12_question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.faq_12_answer: TOOSA currently accepts major payment methods including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and Apple Pay.
